system.description: When you use Enlarge, if you spend an additional 2 Might, you grow to a height of 16 feet (5 m). While huge, you add +1 to your Might Edge, you can ignore the first three moderate wounds you take, your unarmed attacks inflict 7 damage, and you gain an asset to tasks that are easier for a larger creature to perform (like climbing or wading). While huge, your dodge tasks are hindered by two steps. Enabler.
